paper.$description: Page background. The default ground for everything.

paper-raised.$description: Cards, inputs, menus and kbd keys sitting on paper.

paper-sunk.$description: Recessed wells: code spans, table headers, footer band.

line.$description: Decorative hairlines and section rules. Never the only boundary of a control.

line-strong.$description: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, cards, tags, kbd. Meets 3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

ink.$description: Primary text and the secondary button border, on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

ink-muted.$description: Metadata, captions and mono labels, on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

neptune.$description: The brand. Primary button fill, links, focus ring, active state. As text, on paper, paper-raised and neptune-soft.

neptune-soft.$description: Tinted ground behind neptune text: accent tags, selected rows, highlights.

on-neptune.$description: Text and icons on a neptune fill.

focus.$description: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 or better on every paper surface.

ok.$description: Healthy / shipped / online state. Always paired with a word. As text, on paper and paper-raised.

alert.$description: Warning, failure or breaking change. Always paired with a word. As text, on paper and paper-raised.

on-alert.$description: Text on an alert fill: the danger button. 5.7:1 (Paper), 9.2:1 (Deep).

term-bg.$description: Terminal and code-block ground. Dark in both themes.

term-muted.$description: Prompts, comments and timestamps on term-bg.

term-accent.$description: Commands, paths and highlights on term-bg.

term-ok.$description: Healthy / done state on term-bg: toast labels. Always with a word.

term-alert.$description: Warning or failure on term-bg: toast labels. Always with a word.

viz-1.$description: Chart series 1. Categorical slots go in order 1→6, never cycled; they follow the entity, not its rank.

viz-3.$description: Chart series 3 (plum). Slots 1–3 are safe for scatter and small multiples; past three, fold into Other or facet.

viz-4.$description: Chart series 4 (green). A series, not a status: status in charts wears ok and alert with a word.

viz-6.$description: Chart series 6 (red). A seventh series folds into Other.

viz-other.$description: The Other series, and anything de-emphasised or greyed out in a chart.

viz-seq-1.$description: Sequential step 1 of 7, for magnitude: heatmaps, choropleths. 1 is least. In Deep the ramp runs dark→light so low values recede into the ground.

viz-div-mid.$description: Diverging midpoint: zero, no change. Neutral, never a hue.

viz-div-neg-1.$description: Diverging negative arm (gold), step 1 of 3; 3 is strongest. Equal steps on both arms.

viz-div-pos-1.$description: Diverging positive arm (blue), step 1 of 3; 3 is strongest.

shadow-press.$description: Hover lift on buttons and linked cards. No blur, ever.

$description: Neptune Paper theme (light). Combine with primitives.tokens.json and base.tokens.json.
